text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki and I are in the middle of
tidying up
after training when we hear a
voice calling from
the track.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fuji! You done trainin' for today?
How 'bout
comin' back for seconds and
trainin' with me a
bit?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, but I think I'll pass. Resting is an

important part of conditioning too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, aren't you confident? Don't cry to
me when
we take first in the next
inter-dorm scrimmage!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You think you can beat Ritto Dorm?
How
very interesting.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Think? I know it! And we'll use today to
get a
headstart on kickin' your butt!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Would it be all right if I trained a little
longer,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In that case, there's no need for me to
hold back!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I swear, she gets more heated
than even
me sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you're right. It really is best that I
rest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What, you're just gonna leave me
hangin'?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Resting your body is how you ensure it
works at
its very best, and I'll need that
to beat you at the
scrimmage!
